theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties leads the ranks with the highest score, full breadth (1.0), eligibility, and a durability_bar of 0.69 — the strongest trend-health leg available in this state. The rotation margin over Gold Miners is razor-thin (0.034), so this is a coin-flip leadership read, not an edge. I lean with the confirmed leader only while its trend-gate stays eligible and the handoff does not confirm.
